decisions.reason: The coffee-based men's line is a standalone niche series with no visible evidence of meeting its aspiration since 2019, so it carries real drop risk, but a small cosmetics maker typically keeps low-cost niche lines while slack allows rather than search for alternatives without a clear shortfall signal.

The cleansing foam extends the established Sandorini series, shares its brand, production and customer base, and costs little to keep, so it is unlikely to fall far enough below aspiration to trigger problemistic search and removal.
